hooks.name: Block generated files
hooks.description: Prevents edits to generated, cached, and lock files. Blocks the write and feeds the reason back as a HOOK_INSTRUCTION.

action.command: file=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.path // .file_path // empty'); [ -z "$file" ] && exit 0; case "$file" in */dist/*|*/coverage/*|*/storybook-static/*|*/__screenshots__/*|*/playwright-report/*|*/test-results/*|*/.vitest/*|*/api/.cache/*|*/node_modules/*|*/package-lock.json|*/api/package-lock.json|*/pokedex-architecture-map.html) echo "Blocked: $file is generated, cached, or a lock file. Regenerate it with the proper command instead of editing it by hand." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
